entities.summary: Arab Revolt, a transformative movement in Syria (1860–1918). Emerged from Tanzimat and Egyptian Occupation and Tanzimat. Catalyzed Faisal and Arab forces enter Damascus and Jamal Pasha executes Arab nationalist leaders in Damascus and Beirut.
